step1_analysis.description: A DRAM bitline sense amplifier designed for low-voltage operation. It features a decoupled NMOS sensing pair and a cross-coupled PMOS pair, along with control switches to sample and cancel threshold voltage mismatches, thereby improving data-retention time and sensing margin.

paper_reference.title: Low-Voltage DRAM Sensing Scheme With Offset-Cancellation Sense Amplifier

sensing_delay.description: Time from sense enable (SX falling) to the output nodes (A/B) resolving to near full swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: With W/L=10 and un*Cox=270uA/V^2, the NMOS drive current is ~300uA. Discharging a 10fF internal node capacitance by 0.9V takes dt = C*dV/I = 10fF*0.9V/300uA ≈ 30ps. Including PMOS turn-on and parasitic delays, expect ~50-150ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on first-order RC and current charging equations for SKY130 parameters at 1.8V.

sensing_power.description: Average power consumption during the sensing phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: Energy to charge internal nodes (10fF) is C*V^2 = 10fF * (1.8V)^2 = 32fJ. Averaged over a 2ns window, P = 32fJ / 2ns = 16uW. Short-circuit currents will add to this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Testbench isolates bitlines, so power is dominated by internal node capacitance charging and short-circuit current.

input_offset_voltage.description: The minimum differential bitline voltage required to overcome device mismatch and resolve correctly.

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard mismatch for large area (W=5u, L=0.5u) is relatively low. With offset cancellation active, the residual offset is limited by charge injection and finite gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Offset cancellation significantly reduces the native Vth mismatch of the SKY130 process.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure the sensing delay and power of the sense amplifier. The bitlines are initialized with a 100mV differential, and the sense amplifier is enabled by pulling SX to ground.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DRAM Offset-Cancellation Sense Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 A N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM7 B BITB SX GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM5 A BIT SX GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 N2 CONAZ A VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 B A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM11 V_BLP BLP BIT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 BITB BLP V_BLP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM9 BITB CONDPRZ A GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM8 B CONBPRZ BIT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM10 BITB BLP BIT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM6 BITB CONCZ B GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM4 N2 CONAZ B GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBLP_SRC V_BLP 0 0.9
VBLP_CTRL BLP 0 0.9
VCONAZ CONAZ 0 1.8
VCONCZ CONCZ 0 0
VCONBPRZ CONBPRZ 0 0
VCONDPRZ CONDPRZ 0 0

VSX SX 0 PWL(0 0.9 1n 0.9 1.1n 0)

CBIT BIT 0 100f
CBITB BITB 0 100f
CA A 0 10f
CB B 0 10f

.ic v(BIT)=0.95 v(BITB)=0.85 v(A)=0.9 v(B)=0.9 v(N2)=0.9

.control
  tran 10p 5n
  
  meas tran t_sense_start when v(SX)=0.45 fall=1
  meas tran t_sense_end when v(B)=1.6 rise=1
  let sense_delay = t_sense_end - t_sense_start
  print sense_delay
  
  meas tran i_integ integ i(VVDD) from=1n to=3n
  let avg_power = -i_integ * 1.8 / 2n
  print avg_power
  
  meas tran v_A_final find v(A) at=4n
  meas tran v_B_final find v(B) at=4n
  
  quit
.endc
.end
